inland_waterway_rule_base.region: Jiangsu section of the Yangtze River

metadata.description: Operational XML representation used by the LLM-RuleVST reasoning pipeline. The content is a research abstraction and not a substitute for official legal text.

rule.premise: Continuous visual, auditory, and available-sensor lookout is required.
rule.required_action: Maintain sufficient situational awareness to detect encounter development.

compliance_cues.cue: Stable observation and timely response to developing traffic.

violation_conditions.condition: A developing encounter is observable but no response is yet evident.

rule.premise: Available relative-motion information indicates whether collision risk exists.
rule.required_action: Evaluate relative bearing, range, DCPA, and TCPA without using future observations.

compliance_cues.cue: Risk assessment is updated as the encounter develops.

violation_conditions.condition: Risk indicators deteriorate without an observable response.

rule.premise: Collision-avoidance action is required after risk has been identified.
rule.required_action: Take an observable and timely maneuver appropriate to the encounter.

compliance_cues.cue: A clear course or speed adjustment occurs before the risk becomes critical.

violation_conditions.condition: Required course alteration is delayed.
Required speed adjustment is absent.

rule.premise: One vessel approaches another from an overtaking sector with closing motion.
rule.required_action: The overtaking vessel keeps clear of the overtaken vessel.

compliance_cues.cue: The overtaking vessel maintains sufficient lateral clearance and controlled relative speed.

violation_conditions.condition: The maneuver produces insufficient passing clearance or an unsafe relative path.
Relative overtaking speed is inconsistent with safe passage.

rule.premise: Two power-driven vessels approach on reciprocal or approximately reciprocal courses.
rule.required_action: Each vessel makes an observable starboard-side avoidance maneuver when required.

violation_conditions.condition: Required alteration is delayed while risk continues to increase.
No observable avoidance action occurs.

rule.premise: Two power-driven vessels cross with collision risk.
rule.required_action: Assign give-way and stand-on roles from the relative geometry.

compliance_cues.cue: The give-way vessel makes an observable maneuver and avoids crossing ahead.

violation_conditions.condition: The give-way maneuver is inconsistent with the required passing relationship.
The give-way vessel does not take an observable avoiding action.

rule.premise: The own ship is assigned the give-way role.
rule.required_action: Take early and observable action to keep clear.

compliance_cues.cue: A course or speed change increases separation.

violation_conditions.condition: No sufficient avoidance action is observed.
Avoidance action occurs too late in the observed causal window.

rule.premise: The own ship is assigned the stand-on role.
rule.required_action: Maintain a predictable course and speed unless intervention becomes necessary.

compliance_cues.cue: Course and speed remain stable while monitoring the give-way vessel.

violation_conditions.condition: An unnecessary or conflicting maneuver reduces predictability.

rule.premise: The vessel operates in a constrained inland channel or near a navigable boundary.
rule.required_action: Remain within the applicable channel corridor and avoid unsafe lateral deviation.

compliance_cues.cue: The vessel maintains a stable path inside the permitted navigation corridor.

violation_conditions.condition: The observed path departs from the permitted corridor or conflicts with channel use.
Speed is inconsistent with the constrained channel condition.
Speed is insufficient to maintain safe and controllable navigation.

rule.premise: The vessel approaches or passes through a bridge navigation area.
rule.required_action: Use an appropriate bridge approach path, speed, and alignment.

compliance_cues.cue: The vessel aligns with the intended opening and maintains a controlled approach.

violation_conditions.condition: Approach alignment or maneuvering is inconsistent with safe bridge passage.
Approach speed is excessive for the bridge area.
Approach speed is insufficient for stable control.

rule.premise: No specific encounter rule is currently dominant.

violation_conditions.condition: No observable violation action.
